# ContinuousControlConversion

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A specialized ANN-to-SNN conversion framework tailored for continuous control tasks (e.g., robotic manipulation) where temporal dynamics and precision are critical, unlike classification-focused conversions. Highlights the need for domain-specific conversion strategies in iNEST, as generic conversion methods fail under continuous feedback loops.
